Opinion of the Judge Accused have not been  found guilty.

The Police Inspector of Kodigehalli Police Station has filed charge sheet against the accused persons for the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 504 r/w 34 of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Brief case of the prosecution is as under :

It is alleged in the charge sheet that marriage of CW.1 was held with accused No.1 on 17.11.2019, at  3 C.C.N0.31868/2021 the time of marriage, as per the demand of the parents of accused, cash of Rs.1,00,000/- and silver and gold ornaments were given as dowry by the parents of CW.1.

After marriage, when CW.1 was lading marital life with accused No.1, CW.1 was subjected to dowry harassment by the accused No.1 to 3 demanding additional dowry of Rs.15,00,000/- from her parents by abusing her in filthy language.
As such, committed the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 504 r/w 34 of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. After receipt of first information by CW-1,
Crime was registered in CR.No.126/2021, dated 18.09.2021 and investigation was taken up.

8. The above points are answered as under :
 Point No.1 : In the NEGATIVE  Point No.2 :

As per final order  for the following :
 REASONS  9. Point No.1 : That CW.1 was subjected to dowry harassment by the accused No.1 to 3 demanding additional dowry of Rs.15,00,000/- from her parents by abusing her in filthy language.

As such,
committed the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 504 r/w 34 of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
10. Prosecution in order to prove the guilt of accused has examined PW1, very complainant is examined as PW1, but PW.1 fully turned hostile to the case of prosecution.
In her evidence she has deposed that  6 C.C.N0.31868/2021 accused have neither harassed her physically and mentally demanding dowry nor abused in filthy language and not assaulted.
She further deposed that accused have not threatened her.
PW1 has identified her signatures in complaint and Mahazar, which are marked as Ex.P1 and 2.
In-fact PW1 does not know Monisha K vs R.K. Vishal on 10 July, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133214682/
4 the contents of Ex.P1 and 2.
11.
Ld.Sr.APP cross-examined them at length, but nothing worth has been elicited.
During the cross- examination Ld.Sr.APP suggested regarding compromise.
PW1 has admitted the same, but she denied that she is deposing false evidence by compromising the matter.
Except the hostile evidence of PW1, there is nothing on record to prove that accused have committed the offenses as alleged in the charge sheet.
Prosecution has not proved the guilt beyond reasonable doubt.

Therefore by extending the  7 C.C.N0.31868/2021 benefit of doubt in favour of accused, I answer Point No.1 in the NEGATIVE.
 12.

Point No.2 : In view of the above discussion,
accused found not guilty and hence, I proceed to pass the following :

ORDER Acting U/s.248 (1) of Cr.P.C. the accused are hereby acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A,
504 r/w 34 of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Bail bonds of accused and their surety bonds stand cancelled after six months from today.
(Dictated to the Stenographer, directly on computer and typed by her revised corrected and then pronounced by me in the open Court on 10th day of July, 2025 ).
